variants.headline: Party leader faces a public scandal
variants.body: A scandal concerning a party leader has come to light in {colony}. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: Leadership under an unwelcome spotlight
variants.body: A party leader is the subject of a newly revealed scandal. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: A scandal tests political trust
variants.body: A scandal about a party leader has become public in the colony. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
